evaluator: evaluator_fast.py, version B, n = 24, margin 8 Delta
guidance_objective: F(u) = S(u) - 20.0 max(E[N](u) - B, 0) (search only; selection by the feasibility rule)
grid: 6^4 phases chi_m in {0,60,...,300} deg at a_m = 0.5 (p_m = 1/4), itertools.product order of mc85_scan.py

nm.parametrisation: x = (z1,z2,z3,chi1..chi4), p = softmax(z1,z2,z3,0), a = sqrt(p), chi mod 2 pi at evaluation
nm.simplex: sim = np.vstack([x0]+[x0+h*e for h, e in zip([H_Z]*3+[H_CHI]*4, np.eye(7))])
nm.call: res = minimize(f, x0, method='Nelder-Mead', options=dict(maxfev=MAXFEV, initial_simplex=sim, xatol=1e-4, fatol=1e-5))
nm.starts: 20 grid points with highest S among 按数值判据可行 (top up by F) + 7 round-2a candidates + 20 random (seed 20261022: rng.dirichlet(ones(4), 20) then rng.uniform(0, 2 pi, (20, 4)))

dense.rule: coordinate-wise around S_found, centre fixed, no re-centring; power: others rescaled proportionally; skip p_m = 1 and negative powers
